race.comment: BRUZANI (1) was doing his best work late last start to get up for second over 1600m at Warracknabeal. Racing more consistently than most and again looks one of the main contenders. WHISTLER GIRL (7) might find this easier than recent starts on the Ballarat Synthetic and draws beautifully in gate 2. ALCOSHARE (4) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1100m at Naracoorte, beaten 3 lengths into sixth. The engagement of Tom Madden is a positive move. Nicely placed to get the prize. GLOVE ARTIST (2) hasn't been able to break through for an extended period, the latest effort a 12th over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic. Best figures measure up nicely and can do a lot better. DETNAW (6) hasn't been able to break through for an extended period, the latest effort a sixth over 1300m at Mt Gambier. Can turn things around.
